annotation.title_clean: Responsible Innovation: Israel's Policy on Artificial Intelligence Regulation and Ethics
annotation.title_en: Responsible Innovation: Israel's Policy on Artificial Intelligence Regulation and Ethics
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Israel Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology; Ministry of Justice (Office of Legal Counsel and Legislative Affairs, Economic Law Department)
annotation.summary_en: English summary of Israel's December 2023 first national AI regulation and ethics policy for the private sector. It favours sector-specific regulators, soft regulation, risk-based and incremental approaches, OECD-based ethical principles, and a new AI Policy Coordination Center, rather than broad horizontal legislation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Empowers sector-specific regulators over horizontal AI legislation
Six regulatory principles: risk-based, interoperability, incremental/sandboxes, soft regulation, multistakeholder
Adopts non-binding ethical AI principles based on OECD AI Principles
Proposes an AI Policy Coordination Center with a steering committee
Calls for regulator forums, sector use mapping, international engagement and a risk management tool
